-- Phase 2: bodies. Contracts and signatures are unchanged from Phase 1.

-- A file name is plain when it is non-empty and names one entry
-- inside the directory: no path separators, no parent references.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() != 1 or name.split("\\").len() != 1
    return False
  True

-- Scans names from index i and returns the text of the first readable
-- plain name, or "" when none can be read.
scan_names(names: List[str], i: int) -> str uses fs =
  if i >= names.len()
    return ""
  if not is_plain_name(names[i])
    return scan_names(names, i + 1)
  let text = fs.read(names[i]) else return scan_names(names, i + 1)
  text

-- Returns the text of the first readable name inside `notes`,
-- or "" when none can be read. Names that are not plain are skipped.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  pre names.len() >= 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  var found = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    found = scan_names(names, 0)
  found

test_plain_names() =
  assert is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  assert is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  assert is_plain_name("") == False
  assert is_plain_name(".") == False
